summary: Comprehensive testing of HERKO Calibration Manager - Full-stack app with FastAPI + React + MongoDB. All 41 backend API tests passed (100%). All frontend UI tests passed. Core workflows verified: Auth, Software Releases, Datasets, Labels, Reviews, Vehicle SW IDs, Traceability.
critical_code_review_comments: A2L parsing is MOCKED - uses fixed label template (seed.py A2L_LABELS_TEMPLATE) instead of real A2L file parsing
No httpOnly cookies for JWT - tokens stored in localStorage (acceptable for demo but not production)
No brute force lockout implemented for login attempts
seed_data_creation: Auto-seeded on startup: 9 demo users, 1 ECU, 3 software releases (2 VALID_FOR_CALIBRATION, 1 DRAFT), 10 datasets across all lifecycle states, 200 labels (20 per dataset), 2 Vehicle_SW_IDs
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core workflows tested and working. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_herko_api.py cover auth, software releases, datasets, labels, reviews, vehicle SW IDs, traceability, and audit log. Frontend verified: login, dashboard KPIs, dataset catalogue, dataset detail with all 6 tabs, label editing, technical validation, V&V attachment, review center, release center, vehicle assignment. A2L import is MOCKED with fixed template.

mocked_apis.A2L file import: Simulated with seed.py A2L_LABELS_TEMPLATE - not real A2L parsing

auth: POST /api/auth/register - creates new user, returns token+user ✓
POST /api/auth/switch-role - changes active_role within assigned roles ✓
software_releases: POST /api/software-releases/{id}/validate - transitions DRAFT with A2L → VALID_FOR_CALIBRATION ✓
datasets: GET /api/datasets/{id} - returns bundle (dataset, software_release, baseline, derived_datasets, vehicle_assignments) ✓
POST /api/datasets - creates dataset only from VALID_FOR_CALIBRATION SR with A2L ✓
POST /api/datasets/{id}/technical-validate - computes PASS/FAIL based on label rules ✓
POST /api/datasets/{id}/submit-approval - EDIT→UNDER_APPROVAL; requires tech validation PASS, changelog, V&V ref ✓
POST /api/datasets/{id}/approve - requires all 4 reviews ACCEPTED, requires PI_Engineering_Manager ✓
frontend: Dashboard shows KPIs and lifecycle tiles ✓
Dataset Catalogue filters and lists all 10 seeded datasets ✓
Dataset Detail with tabs (Overview, Labels, Changelog, Review & Approval, Deployment, Audit Trail) ✓
Inline label edit works for EDIT-state dataset ✓

business_rules_verified: Cannot create DS from invalid SR ✓
Submit for approval requires tech validation PASS + changelog + V&V ref ✓
Post-sales derived datasets only from RELEASED baseline ✓
